name: Limitless AI
tagline: Limitless is winding down after Meta's acquisition: replace the recorder with a note-taker, and the follow-up work with GAIA
painPoints: Limitless captures meetings and conversations passively but doesn't take action on them — follow-ups, tasks, and calendar updates still require manual work
The Pendant wearable captures everything in your physical environment, but digital productivity — email, tasks, calendar — remains outside its scope
No email integration: Limitless doesn't read your inbox, create tasks from emails, or connect meeting context to email threads
Primarily a capture and recall tool; it surfaces what was said but doesn't organize, prioritize, or automate next steps
Cloud-dependent with no self-hosted option — sensitive meeting recordings are stored on Limitless's infrastructure
metaTitle: Limitless AI Alternative: Memory That Acts on Your Meetings
metaDescription: Limitless captures conversations but leaves follow-ups to you. GAIA turns meeting context into tasks, draft replies, and calendar updates. See the switch steps.
whyPeopleLook:
Limitless AI (formerly Rewind) made the Limitless Pendant, a clip-on wearable that recorded and transcribed conversations, plus apps that turned them into searchable summaries. Meta acquired Limitless, stopped selling the Pendant, ended the service in several regions (including the EU and UK) and moved remaining customers to a free plan while it winds down. That is why people are looking for a replacement now. The right Limitless alternative depends on which half you used: the recording, or what you did with it afterwards.

If you want the recording: other AI wearables such as Plaud NotePin and Omi capture in-person conversations, and meeting note-takers such as Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Granola and Fathom transcribe Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls with no hardware. If you used Rewind for screen history, look at Screenpipe or Microsoft Recall on Copilot+ PCs. GAIA does none of this: it does not record audio, transcribe meetings or capture your screen.

If you want the follow-through: a transcript is only useful once someone acts on it, and that is the part Limitless left to you. GAIA is an AI assistant that works from your email, calendar and tasks. Paste a meeting summary from any note-taker, or let GAIA pick up the recap email in your Gmail, and it pulls out the action items, creates todos with due dates, drafts the follow-up email and finds a time for the next meeting. It remembers facts and decisions across conversations, and it runs workflows in the background, such as a morning briefing that lists the follow-ups still open from yesterday's meetings.

Many people pair the two: a note-taker records, GAIA acts. Choose a dedicated recorder if capture is the job. Choose GAIA when the job is turning what was said into sent emails, scheduled meetings and finished tasks.

migrationSteps: Export your meeting summaries and transcripts from Limitless while the service is still running
Paste the decisions and open action items into a GAIA chat and ask it to remember them and create todos
Connect Gmail and Google Calendar so GAIA can correlate meeting context with email threads and upcoming events
Create a workflow that runs when your note-taker's recap email arrives: GAIA creates the tasks and drafts the follow-up email
If you still need recording, pick a note-taker or wearable that emails its recap to the inbox GAIA reads

faqs.question: Does GAIA record meetings like Limitless AI?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not record audio, transcribe meetings or offer a wearable like the Limitless Pendant. It reads your calendar and email and acts on meeting notes you give it: paste a transcript or summary, or let it pick up your note-taker's recap email, and it creates the tasks, drafts the follow-ups and schedules the next meeting.

faqs.question: Is there a source-available alternative to Limitless AI?
faqs.answer: GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) and self-hostable via Docker, a privacy advantage over Limitless, which stores recordings on its own cloud infrastructure. Self-hosted GAIA keeps your meeting notes, tasks and memory on your own servers.

faqs.question: What is Rewind AI called now?
faqs.answer: Rewind AI renamed itself Limitless AI when it launched the Pendant wearable and moved from screen recording to conversation capture. Meta later acquired Limitless, stopped hardware sales, and is winding the service down.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace both Limitless and my task manager?
faqs.answer: GAIA covers the action side of what Limitless captured, with full task management, email management and calendar coordination. For passive audio capture of in-person conversations, pair GAIA with a note-taker or wearable; for digital-first work, GAIA covers the loop from email to calendar to tasks.

faqs.question: What are the best Limitless Pendant alternatives?
faqs.answer: For hardware that records in-person conversations, look at other AI wearables such as Plaud NotePin or Omi, and check each one's privacy terms and local recording-consent rules before you wear it. If you only need calls, a meeting note-taker (Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Granola, Fathom) needs no hardware at all. GAIA is not a recorder: it is the assistant that acts on the notes those tools produce.

faqs.question: What is the best Rewind AI alternative for screen history?
faqs.answer: Rewind recorded your screen so you could search anything you had seen. The closest replacements are Screenpipe, which records screen and audio on your own computer, and Microsoft Recall, built into Copilot+ PCs on Windows. GAIA does not record your screen; it handles the other half of the job: tasks, email and calendar.

faqs.question: Is Limitless AI still available?
faqs.answer: Only while it winds down. After the Meta acquisition, Limitless stopped selling the Pendant, ended paid subscriptions, moved existing customers to a free plan and shut the service down in several regions, including the EU and UK. Existing Pendant owners were promised support for a limited period, so export your transcripts and summaries while you can.

comparisonRows.gaia: Long-term memory of the facts and decisions you share, plus context from your email and calendar, queryable and actionable across your workload
comparisonRows.competitor: Captures in-person and virtual conversations through the pendant or a desktop recording agent; stores searchable transcripts and AI-generated summaries queryable via a chat interface

comparisonRows.competitor: No active email management; can surface email context when querying conversation history, but does not read, triage, draft, or act on inbox messages

comparisonRows.gaia: Dedicated task system with deadlines and tracking fed by meetings, beyond suggested action items
comparisonRows.competitor: Can identify action items mentioned in recorded meetings and suggest them post-summary; no dedicated task system, project hierarchy, or deadline tracking

comparisonRows.gaia: Cross-tool workflow engine: meeting outcomes trigger email, calendar, and task actions automatically
comparisonRows.competitor: No workflow automation engine; core function is capture and recall, not execution or cross-tool orchestration

comparisonRows.gaia: No wearable or recording agent needed: works with the devices you own on web, desktop, mobile, and chat
